title: StepFun Opens 600B Parameter Step 5 Preview as Open Weights Flagship
summary:
The company's latest AI architecture is now available for download on Hugging Face and ModelScope in BF16 and FP8 precision. This flagship model, named Step 5 Preview, utilizes a sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture with 600B total parameters and 27B active per token. It features a 1M token context window and native vision capabilities, designed specifically for agentic workflows such as software engineering, coding, and professional knowledge work in finance.

Infrastructure partners vLLM and SGLang launched Day 0 support for the model upon its release. vLLM added compatibility for Blackwell and Hopper GPUs and introduced RL training through verl and an NVFP4 version of the weights. SGLang implemented MTP decoding and cache aware routing, which the project noted is already serving the model in production environments.
